census: 2018 Malawi Population and Housing Census (2018 PHC)

source.title: 2018 Malawi Population and Housing Census, Series A. Population Tables, Table A1: Population of Malawi by Sex at National, Regional and District Levels, 2008 and 2018

copy_read.held_by: HDX (Humanitarian Data Exchange), dataset 'Malawi - Population and Housing Census 2018' (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi-population-and-housing-census-2018), uploaded by Health Cluster, not by the NSO: HDX lists Health Cluster as both contributor and source, added 09 February 2023

source.note: Not compared with a copy from the NSO's own site: the NSO census page renders its content by script and its publication list could not be read as HTML. The reference date is the enumeration period, 3 to 23 September 2018, as HDX's dataset description gives it.

licence.stated: none stated by the NSO; HDX labels the dataset 'Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY)'
licence.where: HDX dataset page (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/142fecf6-cfc3-4a32-8277-3a601a46337d), read 2026-11-20: the label is HDX's, set by the uploader (Health Cluster), not the NSO's. NSO site (www.nsomalawi.mw: home, /census/2018, /about, /faq), read 2026-11-20: the pages render their content by script, and the HTML holds only menus and the footer 'Copyright © 2026 National Statistical Office of Malawi. All Rights Reserved'; no terms-of-use page found (/terms-of-use and /terms return 404). The workbook carries no notice.
licence.redistributed: the 2018 counts of Table A1, transcribed and cited, with attribution to the National Statistical Office of Malawi; the workbook is not redistributed

transcription.by: read from the workbook's cells (B5:D43) with Fieldwork's xlsx reader, not typed; each value checked against the sheet's XML
transcription.as_published: names as the workbook writes them, with a leading space removed from Neno. The 2008 columns (E:G) are left out: this repository holds the latest census.

checks.districts_and_cities_sum_to_their_region: 3 of 3 regions, men, women and total

units: counts.csv: the country, its 3 regions (Northern, Central, Southern), 28 districts and 4 cities (Mzuzu City, Lilongwe City, Zomba City, Blantyre City), as printed. A city is counted apart from the district of the same name (Lilongwe City apart from Lilongwe): a region's total is the sum of its districts and cities.

reviewed.found: First transcription, from HDX's copy (uploaded by Health Cluster). The 2018 PHC is the latest census.

offered.why: Fieldwork offers each level as its own table, with geoBoundaries' name for each unit, so the census relates to a map without anyone retyping a name. The printed counts (counts.csv) stay here as the source, and every check runs on them. The districts table adds each city to the district geoBoundaries draws it in; the counts as printed keep the four cities as units of their own.

districts.label: Its 28 districts with their cities, with geoBoundaries' names
districts.what: The 28 districts, each with the city geoBoundaries draws inside it added, and geoBoundaries' name and ID, written by scripts/levels_today.py. Derived: a district with a city is the sum of two printed rows.
districts.how: Table A1 counts Mzuzu, Lilongwe, Zomba and Blantyre cities apart from the districts. geoBoundaries' MWI ADM2 has 28 units, the districts, by the same names, with no city of its own, so each city's count is added to the district it lies in: Mzuzu City in Mzimba, the other three in the district of the same name. Each was checked by an approximate city-centre point lying in that district's polygon.

boundaries.what: geoBoundaries gbOpen MWI ADM2 (National Statistics Office of Malawi, OCHA ROSEA, 2020, CC BY 3.0 IGO) at commit 9469f09, the simplified files, read and not kept here

does_not_establish: That a city's boundary lies wholly inside one district: only its centre was placed.
